statistical_framework:
replicate_unit: calvaria from biologically distinct mice within designated comparisons; marker panels/regions/cells not independent mice
display_error: mean ± SD in original captions
tests: 
  [1] two-tailed t-test
  [2] one-way ANOVA with Tukey
  [3] two-way ANOVA with Bonferroni
p_values: only original caption exact values or visual thresholds; no recomputation
source_data_summaries: extractor arithmetic means and sample SD (ddof=1), preserving available numerical n
sample_size_planning: no a priori statistical sample size calculation reported
randomization: reported for all experiments
blinding: not performed for light-sheet acquisition/analysis; microCT acquisition blinded, analysis not blinded
data_exclusion: authors report none; does not repair missing deposited records
control_reuse: 9 exact comparisons verified for adult Fig3/4 controls; do not sum as independent evidence

protocol_records:
record_id: A131-PR01
title: 固定颅盖骨的整装免疫染色与TDE透明化
record_type: partially_reported_protocol
purpose: 保存原文共同流程并保留标记支路
applicability: 已固定、保留骨膜/硬脑膜的颅盖骨；不含灌流、缺损建立、PTH给药或模型工程
start_state: 4%无甲醇PFA4°C过夜固定并PBS洗3次的颅盖骨
end_state: TDE透明化整装样本
materials: 
  [1] wash buffer：0.1MTris、0.15MNaCl、0.05%V/V Tween20、20%V/V DMSO,pH7.5
  [2] blocking：wash buffer+10%V/V normal donkey serum；biotin blocking kitSP-2002
  [3] CD31 AF3628 goat1:100；Emcn sc-65495 rat1:50；Osterix ab209484 rabbit1:200；Gli1 SAB4301901-100UL rabbit1:100；Vpp3 ab200839 rabbit1:200
  [4] donkey anti-goatAF800plusA32930 (0.67mg/mL,1:50)；anti-rabbitAF647plusA32795(0.67mg/mL,1:150)；anti-ratbiotinA18749(0.75mg/mL,1:100)；streptavidinAF555S32355(0.67mg/mL,1:100)。括号mg/mL为原表产品浓度，与工作稀释分开。
  [5] TDE in TBS-Tween；TBS-Tween在透明化句中未单独配方，不等同含20%DMSO wash buffer
preparation_and_warnings: 
[]
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A131-PR01-S01
    title: 封闭与整装染色
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A131-PR01-001
        action: 血清封闭后封闭内源性生物素
        reported_parameters: 
          serum_block: overnight4°C
          biotin_block: 8hRT
        source_raw: biotin blocking kit for 8 h at room temperature
        source_refs: 
          [1] protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A131/sources/article.html Methods/Whole-mount immunostaining and optical clearing
        legacy_positions: 
[]
        source_excerpt_type: verbatim_excerpt_whitespace_restored_from_source
        source_text_file: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A131/sources/methods.txt
      [2]         step_id: A131-PR01-002
        action: 一抗、二抗和streptavidin依次孵育，阶段间真实重复洗涤
        reported_parameters: 
          primary: 7days,CD31/Emcn and Osterix orGli1；Vpp3见补图5
          secondary: 7days
          streptavidin: 5days,Emcn amplification
          base: same blocking buffer
          between_wash: 5times over24h
          staining_temperature: 此段未报，不能从A133填4°C
        source_raw: Calvaria were washed five times over a 24 h period
        source_refs: 
          [1] protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A131/sources/article.html Methods/Whole-mount immunostaining and optical clearing
        legacy_positions: 
[]
        source_excerpt_type: verbatim_excerpt_whitespace_restored_from_source
        source_text_file: protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A131/sources/methods.txt
  [2]     section_id: A131-PR01-S02
    title: 透明化
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A131-PR01-003
        action: TDE逐级透明，保留末端100%的两次处理
        reported_parameters: 
          TDE: 
            [1] 25%
            [2] 50%
            [3] 75%
            [4] 90%
            [5] 100%
            [6] 100%
          base: TBS-Tween
          per_step_alternatives: 
            [1] 2hRT
            [2] overnight4°C
          percentage_basis: not specified
        source_raw: 25%,50%,75%,90%,100%×2
        source_refs: 
          [1] protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A131/sources/article.html Methods/Whole-mount immunostaining and optical clearing
        legacy_positions: 
[]
        source_excerpt_type: compact_parameter_transcription_not_verbatim_quote
        source_raw_note: 此字段保留原数值/单位的紧凑摘录，不声称逐字引文；源文精确定位见source_refs。
cases: 
  [1]     case_id: A131-MARKERS
    scope: 标记组合按实验
    source_raw: CD31+Emcn+Osterix或Gli1；Vpp3在SupplementalFig5另示，不默认所有标记同染
    source_refs: 
      [1] protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A131/sources/article.html Methods/Whole-mount immunostaining and optical clearing
      [2] supplement.pdf p6 SupplFig5
      [3] protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A131/sources/supplement.pdf pp8–9 Table1
  [2]     case_id: A131-TDE-SCHEDULE
    scope: 每步时程原文为or
    source_raw: 2h room temperature or overnight4°C
    relationship: 互斥时温选择；每样本实际选择未逐项报告

    [2] protocol_content_revision_20261008/recent/A131/sources/supplement.pdf pp8–9 Table1

Note.Text22:
findings:
topic: cross-paper inheritance
finding: A131 and A133 share a method family, but staining temperatures, wash timing, working dilutions and acquisition branches differ. Their values are not cross-filled.

Note.Text23:
findings:
topic: timing
finding: Stage-specific stain/clearing times stay separate from sample age, post-fracture day and approximately five-hour image acquisition. Alternative per-step temperature/time schedules do not become a measured total duration.

Note.Text24:
findings:
topic: marker identity
finding: CD31/Emcn plus Osterix OR Gli1; Vpp3 is separately documented. Gray/green/red are display colors, not fluorophore names. The secondary/streptavidin identity chain agrees with Supplementary Table 1.

Note.Text25:
findings:
topic: denominator
finding: 45 calvaria is whole-study image total, not each panel n. The observed source-table versus caption discrepancies and uncertain specimen reuse remain unresolved, not silently corrected.

Note.Text26:
findings:
topic: measurement scope
finding: MicroCT links apply only to bone readouts, not to cell counts bundled within a mixed observation. The six normal light-sheet VOIs and defect/ipsilateral/contralateral VOIs remain separate.
